quote: Casale… proudly announces the signing of a definitive $465 million Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) contract with ATOME PLC… world’s first green fertilizer plant in Villeta, Paraguay… produce 260,000 tonnes of zero-carbon fertiliser per year using 100% renewable baseload power… The Villeta site benefits from a 145MW renewable power purchase agreement and is situated in a tax-free zone… total estimated cost of US$625 million
note: Opened Casale company EPC announcement 7 Apr 2025.
